title: Hill’s puts cat food at the center of growth strategy
summary: Hill’s Pet Nutrition recorded a 5.6% year-over-year (YoY) increase in net sales to $1.2 billion (€1.04B) in the third quarter (Q3) of fiscal year (FY) 2026, accounting for 22% of the group’s total net sales. Organic sale…
ai_summary: Hill’s Pet Nutrition focuses on cat food as a key growth area, reporting a 5.6% YoY increase in net sales to $1.2 billion in Q3 FY2026. The segment accounts for 22% of the group’s total net sales, highlighting its importance to the company’s strategy.
